item.title: Version 1.5.61
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.61 Update

  • 🔐 Safer Script Inputs
    - Shell Script actions now receive selected text, copied text, clipboard text, and prompt input through quoted ONTEXT_* environment variables instead of inserting them into command source.
    - Existing Shell actions show a reviewable migration before running, while commands that cannot be migrated safely stop with clear guidance.
    - AppleScript actions now pass user-controlled placeholder values as runtime data instead of inserting them into AppleScript source.
  • 💄 Dialog and Settings Polish
    - Fixed prompt, preview, and command-error text that could become unreadable in Light or Dark appearance.
    - Refined the Liquid Glass Actions preview shadow and spacing, and removed unwanted scrolling and scrollbars.
  • 📚 Safer Script Documentation
    - Updated Shell Script examples to use quoted environment variables and added clear guidance for clipboard text and legacy action migration.
